profile_text.body:
Apple is a public company founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, CA, that designs and sells consumer hardware, software, and services. Its website focuses on Apple Intelligence, which the company describes as AI that is integrated into apps, grounded in user context, and private at every step. The next-generation Apple Intelligence and Siri are presented as coming later this year and set to feature across iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27, with initial availability in English and a noted exclusion from the EU on iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS at launch.

Apple tracks three AI products on this site: Apple Intelligence, categorized as a chat and general LLM built around on-device processing, Private Cloud Compute, and Apple silicon with a stated privacy-first approach; Final Cut Pro AI, a Mac video editing tool using on-device processing optimized for Apple silicon; and iMovie AI, a consumer video editing product with trailer templates also running on-device. The site describes Siri AI as capable of open-ended conversation, in-app actions across Messages, Music, and Reminders, image and real-world object recognition, writing assistance with style matching, and Shortcuts automation from plain-language descriptions.

Apple is a publicly traded company on the ticker AAPL with SEC CIK 0000320193. Its most recently filed 10-K, covering the period ending September 27, 2025, reported revenue of $416,161,000,000. Two MCP servers are registered in connection with Apple: one for managing Apple Ads campaigns and reporting, and one providing Apple Developer Documentation with semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI reranking for MCP clients. No litigation is recorded in the held facts.
